retained_include.mechanism: Rename only its main while including existing typed array/count/ID/telemetry utilities. Exactly one retained AppInfo definition. New --solver never calls the observer-only old entry/completion.

entry.behavior: Derived actual JSphGpuSingle sets only protected PorosityObserver=true and PorosityFeedback=true, then calls actual Run. No physical field, clock, material, PDE or native state is rewritten by the fixture.
outputs: live_final.csv: ID-sorted live GPU J,n,theta after actual final download
entry.scope: Fresh private CPU-equivalent k=0 2D no-wall XZ-periodic small-amplitude elastic window; shared public GPU dynamic switch remains false/rejected. Actual finite/material/init/time-policy guards remain in force.

jobs_after_admission_only.successful_Debug_smoke_first: One new actual GPU feedback Run of exactly2 completed steps, dt=2^-24,TimeOut=dt,TimeMax=2^-23,3native frames. Run --solver-smoke under actual memcheck, then --read-smoke GPU DATA DT NEW_REVIEW_DIR. This explicitly reaches real successful Pre/Corr rather than treating first-force rejection components as a successful-step proof. No CPU smoke is added.
jobs_after_admission_only.GPU: Two fresh actual Run coarse/half jobs, private flags true; public master false. Every single-run review passes before next.
jobs_after_admission_only.CPU: Two fresh canonical CPU coarse/half jobs using public master true, conductivity model0 and k0, same retained BI4 and initialization. The old public CPU reader hardcodes nonzero k and is not used unchanged.
jobs_after_admission_only.initial: Exact retained native positions and float vx=(1/512)sin(2pi*x/Lx); vy=vz=p=p0=sigma=theta=0,J=1,n=.25. BI4 copy byte-exact; no new GenCase.
jobs_after_admission_only.cadence: 2^-23 seconds;257 actual saved frames including initial and final
jobs_after_admission_only.input_binding: Root-owned driver must verify all runtime XML material, options and only the intended CPU/GPU public-master distinction before execution; native files do not independently store every constitutive constant.

offline_reader.cli: --read GPU|CPU DATA_DIR DT NEW_REVIEW_DIR, or --read-smoke GPU DATA_DIR DT NEW_REVIEW_DIR
offline_reader.exactly_two_declared_windows: Full CPU/GPU:257samples,End2^-15,cadence2^-23,dt2^-24/2^-25. GPU smoke only:3samples,End2^-23,cadence=dt2^-24,2completed steps. No arbitrary samples/end/cadence argument or CPU short mode.
checks_all_declared_native_frames: one piece,512 unique contiguous native IDs,no exclusions,2D/fixed species and XZ periodicity
exact saved time=part*declared cadence, positive Step=completed_steps-1 and locked dt metadata
all original15 typed native arrays finite, stored double stress plus rounded legacy stress
actual three J arrays finite; J>.75,abs(J-1)<=1e-4,0<n<1 and solid-volume ledger<=5e-13
saved coupled CFL<=.01 and entire declared-window energy ratio<=1.1
full natural max abs(J-1)>1e-8;2step smoke only requires max abs(J-1)>0
offline_reader.smoke_nonempty_scope: Short maxJ>0 is a separate explicitly declared nonempty smoke condition, not a relaxation/adoption of the full257-frame maxJ>1e-8 threshold. Full half/cross/physical acceptance does not follow from smoke.
offline_reader.CPU_native_schema: Three J arrays plus actual native V/rho/k arrays and PosDiv are required. V/rho checked against J with existing5e-13 relative ledger bound;k exactly0. Four public model metadata keys are typed and true/schema1/model0/Ck0.
offline_reader.GPU_native_schema: Exactly the observer-style three J arrays are required; CPU V/rho/k and PosDiv arrays plus public dynamic metadata are absent. Common V,rho_t,k0 are explicitly derived from J/declared zero conductivity, never called native observations.
offline_reader.energy: Sum V(J)[rho_t(J)|v|^2/2+dev(sigma):dev(sigma)/(4G)+tr(sigma)^2/(18K)+n*p^2/(2Kw)], initial nonzero. Necessary scales/energy budget are not sufficient stability or conservation proof.
offline_reader.physical_binary: Little-endian three uint32 header [512,33,257] for full or [512,33,3] for GPU smoke, then each frame one binary64 actual time followed by512 native-ID-sorted rows of33 binary64 values. No PosDiv column and no missing-field zero substitution.
offline_reader.material_displacement: Position at each actual frame minus same native ID initial position, full XYZ. This weak window remains inside primary domain so no periodic-wrap inference.
offline_reader.stress_shear_order: Native SigmaState_ij=(xy,yz,xz); common columns reorder explicitly to xy,xz,yz.
offline_reader.theta_scope: Stored last force-stage theta diagnostic, not a fresh endpoint divergence observation. Reader does not assert a pressure-log theory identity.

later_root_analysis_not_implemented_here.independent_halves_each_backend: All257 actual time/ID-matched pressure RMS<=5Pa, max vector material displacement difference<=.005mm, normalized pressure RMS/Pstar, velocity vector RMS/A and displacement vector RMS/Ustar each<=1e-4.
later_root_analysis_not_implemented_here.same_dt_CPU_GPU_cross: Original pressure RMS<=5Pa and max vector material displacement difference<=.005mm at all257 samples. Normalized p/v/u and J/stress differences recorded descriptively, not new hard cross gates.
later_root_analysis_not_implemented_here.passive_density: CPU rational and GPU additive legacy-density correctors are known different; no backend equality requirement on passive Rhop. Both original validity guards remain.
later_root_analysis_not_implemented_here.theory: Continuum/discrete modal comparisons may be added offline but are not fabricated by the native reader.

Successful real Debug2step GPU feedback smoke must pass typed native review and actual memcheck zeroerrors/zeroleaks before full jobs

limits: No automatic run authorization from authoring or successful compilation
No nonzero-k Darcy, dynamic acceleration-gradient pressure pass, general walls or gravity acceptance
No public GPU master enable or server/formal release
